messages:
maria: Heads up — we need to push the pin for model-serving v1.22.0 to prod tonight at 23:00 PT. Change window starts in ~2h. Who can press? MFA required for deployer role.

deploy-bot: Deployment reserved. Release v1.22.0 queued by maria. Canary job started (3/5). To proceed, a user with the "deployer" role must run: `deploy-bot press --release v1.22.0`. MFA check enforced.

jon: I can press if needed, I'm on rotation but available. @maria confirm rollback plan and whether DB migrations are included.

maria: No DB migrations this deploy. It's config + model-serving binary + routing tags. Rollback plan: pin back to v1.21.9 and revert routing in <5m. Release notes + checklist: https://git.internal/r/redwood/release/1234

akshay: Quick Q — do we want an extended canary (20% for 30m) given weekend traffic pattern? I think yes to catch any perf regressions.

sre-bot: Canary health metrics: healthy=98%, error-rate=0.02%, p95 latency=120ms. No anomaly detected. :white_check_mark:

linda: I do not have the deployer role. Can we grant a temporary JIT to @linda until 02:00 PT? @infra please?

jon: JIT looks fine to me. Use the JIT flow: `auth-jit request --user linda --scope deployer --ttl 3h` then infra approves. Remember to rotate creds after.

infra: Approved JIT for linda for 3h. MFA device check logged. Email with approval link sent to linda. Logging note: JIT-req-4912345678.

linda: Got the JIT link and MFA prompt. Running `deploy-bot press --release v1.22.0 --canary 20` now.

deploy-bot: Press accepted from linda. Canary rollout: 20% traffic. Monitor with `rk logs -f canary` and `rk metrics query deploy:v1.22.0`. If issues, run `deploy-bot rollback --release v1.21.9` or `deploy-bot abort`.

jon: Monitoring dashboards — metrics look stable so far, traces normal. :thumbsup:

maria: If anything looks off, rollback immediately. Tag the release in the notes and mention the canary duration.

sre-bot: Canary stable at 20% for 15m. No regression alerts triggered. Autopromote scheduled in 15m.

linda: Promoting to 100% traffic now.

deploy-bot: Rolling to 100% for v1.22.0. Expected completion in ~5m.

sre-bot: Rollout complete. No incidents logged. p95 latency unchanged, error-rate nominal. Change window clear. Please add a short entry under releases: "prod: v1.22.0 — serving perf improvements / routing tweak" and close the ticket.

maria: Thanks team. Please reset JIT and rotate temp creds, and add follow-up metrics doc.

jon: I'll open a follow-up doc with post-deploy metrics and the canary graphs.

linda: All good from my side. Removing temp role now. :white_check_mark:
